name: ABB Virtual World
summary:
The electricity reaching your home, the robots building your car, the systems managing power grids across continents -- ABB technology is behind more of daily life than most people realize. ABB Virtual World is where you get to see it.

This is a free, public VR experience open to anyone on the planet. No ABB account. No engineering degree. Just put on your headset and explore.
